title: Indirimbo y'imisozi mu kabwibwi
intro: Umva uko ibibaya byumvikana bisingiza hamwe n'umugaragu watoranijwe wa Allah. Ijwi rifite impano yo gucuranga, urubanza rushakishwa n'amakimbirane mu cyumba, n'icyuma cyoroshye kubera itegeko ry'Imana gitegereje kuvumburwa. Ni iyihe shusho yo kuramya no gukiranuka ivuga binyuze muri ibi bimenyetso?
clues: Imana yampaye umugisha mwinshi n'ijwi ryiza ry'ishimwe.
Imana yigishije kumva imvugo y'urubanza ruboneye hagati y'abashyamiranye.
Nahanganye n'intwari ikomeye mu rugamba, kandi ku bushake bwa Allah narabatsinze.
Nahawe ubwenge, ububasha n'igitabo cya Zaburi cyahishuwe kivuye kuri Allah.
Nafatanyije n'imisozi n'inyoni mu guhimbaza Imana hamwe nanjye nimugoroba no izuba riva.
Imana yigishije gukora amakoti y'ibyuma mu cyuma cyankoze mu buryo bworoshye.

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
